name: forever-flips
description: What to craft and flip on WoW: Forever, from your saved game data: the Forever Flips addon, Auctionator and TSM prices.
long_description: Reads what the game saves (after a /reload): the Forever Flips addon's scans, queue, bags, bank and AH mail, Auctionator's price database and the TSM app's AuctionDB data, and works it out with the addon's own logic. Read-only. Tools: status, best_crafts, craft_plan, item, deals, leveling, queue, sales.
